{{dablink|For the chapter in ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'' by a similar name, see ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 28|To the Tower of Ghenjei]]''. For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
The '''Tower of Ghenjei''' is a gateway into the world of the [[Eelfinn]] and the [[Aelfinn]].

It lies near the [[River Arinelle]] ten days north of [[Whitebridge]], and it is a solid and spotless metal tower, two hundred feet high without any doors or windows.{{ref/book|1|24}} There is no opening on it; if one draws the symbol for the game of [[Snakes and Foxes]] on the tower's surface with a bronze knife, then a doorway will appear.

The Tower of Ghenjei is accessible through both the waking world and ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. Once someone enters the Tower Of Ghenjei and moves away from the doorway, the doorway (probably) cannot be found again (maybe it disappears, maybe it is just a matter of orientating), and  it is extremely hard to leave the Tower. Before moving away from the doorway, it is possible to leave and the doorway disappear afterwards{{Ref/book|13|53}}. In ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', the leaving is all but impossible.{{ref/book|4|28}}

[[Bayle Domon]] points out the tower to [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] after Rand spots something glinting in the distance while traveling on the ''[[Spray]]'' down the Arinelle. Captain Domon says that the tower is a marker for river traders.{{ref/book|1|24}}

[[File:Tower.jpg|thumb|left]]

==Recent events==
The Tower is the entrance to the world where [[Moiraine Damodred]] is being held. As according to her letter to [[Thom Merrilin]], she is rescued by him, Mat, and [[Noal Charin]]. Noal is the only one of the rescuers not to escape alive, although Mat loses one of his eyes in order to save Moiraine.

==Inside the Tower==
There are a few people known to have been inside the Tower of Ghenjei:
* [[Slayer]] - fled into the Tower in ''Tel'aran'rhiod''.{{ref/book|4|28}}
* Moiraine Damodred - held captive.{{ref/book|11|10}}
* [[Lanfear]] who went into the world of the Eelfinn and the Aelfinn at the same time as Moiraine.
* Thom Merrilin, Matrim Cauthon, and Noal Charin (Jain Farstrider) - came to rescue Moiraine.{{ref/book|13|53}}
* [[Birgitte Silverbow]] - entered in a previous life as Jethari together with [[Gaidal Cain]]. They never came out alive.{{ref/book|13|22}}
* An unidentified man. Presumably [[Moridin]] coming for [[Lanfear]] (or her body).{{ref/book|13|56}}
